title: Incredible Places in India
description: From the Taj Mahal to the Himalayas, Kerala's backwaters to Rajasthan's deserts — India's landscapes will leave you speechless. #india #travel #tajmahal #incredibleindia

scenes.text: India holds some of the most breathtaking places on Earth.
The Taj Mahal, a monument built entirely out of love.
The mighty Himalayas, crowned in eternal snow.
The calm green backwaters of Kerala.
And the golden deserts of Rajasthan.
One country, and every landscape you could ever dream of.
